Brighten up your home this Christmas with these enchanting LED Icicle lights Christmas decorations. The perfect addition to any festive display. Featuring twenty four icicles illuminated by bright non-replaceable White LEDs, these are perfect for anywhere around your home or garden whether you choose to place them on a mantle piece, wall or Christmas Tree. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use (transformer must remain dry at all times).
